Motorists and pedestrians navigate EDSA-Muñoz in Quezon City on Thursday, July 31. 

The Department of Public Works and Highways announced that the EDSA Rehabilitation Project, originally scheduled to begin this year, has been postponed to 2027. 

The delay follows President Marcos Jr.'s directive to allow time for scientific studies and the exploration of new technologies aimed at minimizing the project’s impact on traffic flow. Planned activities include concrete reblocking and asphalt resurfacing on damaged sections, road widening, sidewalk enhancements, drainage system upgrades, improved lighting and signage, as well as maintenance work on bridges and flyovers. 

📸: Santi San Juan | MB
